title: Banana Smoothie Bowl
description: A thick chilled banana and mango smoothie topped with oats, chia seeds and almonds, ready in ten minutes with no cooking.
steps: Blend the frozen banana, mango, curd and honey until thick and smooth, adding a splash of cold water only if the blender sticks.
Pour into two bowls and smooth the top with a spoon.
Scatter the oats, chia seeds and chopped almonds over each bowl.
Eat straight away so the toppings stay crunchy.
